headline: Owner rule 26 (11-18) puts any new Guild work behind the owner's yes. The Guild finishes in-flight outcome-free checks and has asked the owner whether to point its runs at the C3-MECH queue (PR #231).
bullets: Live reps (REPS3): forecast setups ran 521 setup-days a week vs 465 forecast (+12%, bench-adjusted). Gen halt and buying-power skips fell from 66/60 to 0 per session. A busier market (SPY range 1.46% vs 1.23%) explains part.

Missed moves (A1, descriptive): Live's misses are still mostly ahead at 09:50, but much of that is selection. What survives is ~4.5 non-ETF moves/day with >= 1 ATR left, no setup or wrong side. That gap is knowing which name and side.

SIDEHUNT: the top direction idea (strength vs SPY at 09:50) is already in the owner's queue. The next, signed volume 09:30-09:50, may just re-label the early move, so it only gets an outcome-free agreement check now.
Trades within one setup-day are correlated (ICC 0.22), so a setup is judged by its setup-days. Earnings Shadow (FAMC): -0.112R without its best day, too early to read.
Owner rules 11-18: promotion standard C3-BAR2, Primary epochs, adversarial review of Primary changes, guardrails (rule 26), reps = active days, mechanism-first research (C3-MECH).
next: Owner answer on GUILD-MECH. Meanwhile: SIDEHUNT step 0 (outcome-free agreement check), FAMC 11-19 (3 events), no new scored studies.
